name: com.sswelm.haf-authoring
description: The bake half of the Humankind Asset Framework: Model Factory, Animation / Vehicle / District / Prop / Projectile / Sound Labs, the bakers and the registries. Install into a Humankind ModTools project; the tools appear under Tools > HAF. Requires the HAF BepInEx plugin at runtime for the pack-based axes (units, districts, props) - the projectile axis needs no plugin.
